plan.notes: Source: The University of Tampa 'Four-Year Degree Plan for Major in Biology, B.S.' (official sample plan PDF, https://ut.smartcatalogiq.com/-/media/institution/ut/cnhs/biology/FourYear%20Degree%20Plan%20for%20Major%20in%20Biology%20BS.pdf), transcribed term by term from the university's current online catalog (Catalog 2026-2027; the plan PDF itself does not print a catalog year). The plan is explicitly a SAMPLE four-year plan for the general biology, organismal and evolutionary biology, and molecular biology concentrations (Category I-III requirements are concentration-specific per the catalog). Course codes/titles/credits taken verbatim; prereq arrays are empty (the plan does not publish per-course prerequisites; not invented). 'BIO Category requirement (I, II or III)' and 'BIO Biology elective' slots are the catalog's own category rows; the specific qualifying BIO course is chosen per the catalog. 'Humanities / Fine Arts or Social Science (Bacc. Exp.)' slots are Baccalaureate Experience general-education category slots. BIO 411 Biology Outcomes Capstone is a 0-credit required course (verified in the current UTampa catalog course description: Credits 0; graded S/U), marked required_zero. Catalog notes carried over: a student must earn a minimum of 124 credit hours for the BS in Biology; upper-division biology courses require completion of the lower-core (BIO 198, 198L, 199, 199L, CHE 152, 153L, 154, 155L, MAT 170) with a grade of 'C' or better in each; the math and natural science components of the Baccalaureate Experience are fulfilled by courses in the sequence (BIO 198, CHE 152, MAT 260). No TCCNS in Florida; transfer_confidence is empty.
